faq: Shipping is free. Orders to the US usually arrive in 9–17 days, Canada, the UK and Australia in 10–20 days, and most other countries in 12–25 days. You'll get a tracking link by email.
How do I track my order?
Use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email, or visit our Track your order page.
What if my order arrives damaged?
Send a photo to support@zenligo.com within 30 days of delivery and we'll send a replacement or refund you.
Yes. Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery. See our Refund policy.
Is this product right for my baby's age?
Each product page lists the age range, materials and safety notes. Please read them before use and always supervise your little one.
Choose 2 or 3 items on the product page and the discount is applied automatically in your cart.
Which payment methods do you accept?
All major cards, plus the wallets shown at checkout. Payments are processed securely and we never see your full card details.
Email support@zenligo.com. We reply within 1 business day, Monday to Friday.
